---
title: "On one machine (Docker Compose)"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# The text below is local/README.md, included so there is one copy to maintain.
include_md <- function(path, base) {
  x <- readLines(path, encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE)
  if (length(x) && grepl("^# ", x[1])) x <- x[-1]          # the article has its own title
  # links relative to the file's folder -> the file on GitHub
  x <- gsub("\\]\\((?!https?://|#)([^)]+)\\)", paste0("](", base, "\\1)"), x, perl = TRUE)
  knitr::asis_output(paste(x, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

The folder [`local/`](https://github.com/immunoplex/i-spi-deployment/tree/main/local)
runs the whole system with `docker compose`, no Kubernetes needed. It is the
quickest way to try I-SPI, to test a release, or to develop against real
services. The automated end-to-end check uses the same stack; see
[Automated checks](checks.html).

```{r, echo = FALSE}
include_md("../../local/README.md", "https://github.com/immunoplex/i-spi-deployment/blob/main/local/")
```
